Argus traced the error spike on io-shop to the monthly-spend-feature flag, which was switched on at 22:37. With the flag on, account page requests failed with a ZeroDivisionError at src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:47, and the error rate went from about 1% to about 30%. No deploy was involved, and all replicas were on one revision.

At 22:43 Argus turned the flag back off. By 22:45 it had confirmed the service was back to normal (since 22:43) and the alert had stopped firing, so it marked the incident MITIGATED.

It also opened a draft fix, PR #352 (https://github.com/ohadraz/Argus-Demo-Target-App/pull/352), which needs someone to review and merge it, and it wrote the postmortem.

The bug is still in the code. If the flag goes back on before the fix is merged, account pages will probably fail again for shoppers who have bought before but not yet this month.
